decision.summary: The exact failure-routed SDPO objective completed rollout admission, sparse student and EMA-teacher scoring, backward, full CPU-offloaded AdamW, EMA update, scheduler update, stable sharded checkpoint writing, and clean launcher shutdown. This admits the implementation for controlled hybrid training; one optimizer step is not behavioral evidence.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B
model.teacher: separate EMA copy initialized from the student

topology.optimizer_cpu_offload: Prime full optimizer-in-backward native CPU offload

optimizer_step.gradient_norm_note: Prime disables clipping and grad-norm collection when full optimizer-in-backward CPU offload is active.

throughput_followup.summary: Restricting sparse teacher and support scoring to active SDPO predictor rows preserved a successful update and stable checkpoint but did not improve the measured bottleneck. The added LM-head interface and indexing complexity was removed; r11 remains the accepted implementation.
throughput_followup.comparison_caveat: r11 and r12 used independent on-policy rollouts, so token counts and trajectories differ. The result is used only to reject an optimization that showed no wall-time or memory benefit, not as a numerical equivalence comparison.

attempts.cause: A 4096-token trainer sequence clipped every assistant action target, producing zero globally active loss tokens; the contemporaneous full-state checkpoint path also exceeded host memory.
One of six Prime Agent rollouts reached max_turns=8, so the batch did not satisfy clean complete admission.
A 9699-token teacher hindsight replay exceeded the then-configured 6144-token trainer sequence.
Teacher replay materialized a full-vocabulary log-softmax and exhausted GPU memory.
Whole-logit finite validation materialized an additional full-vocabulary boolean tensor and exhausted GPU memory.
The compiled full-logit logsumexp path materialized an FP32 tensor of shape [1, 7006, 248320] (about 6.48 GiB) and exhausted GPU memory during backward.

Exact sparse fused scoring completed forward, backward, and AdamW, but the post-step EMA update mixed an unsharded teacher tensor with a student DTensor after no-reshard LM-head execution. No checkpoint was accepted.
Stopped prospectively before rollouts or gradients after identifying the teacher no-reshard lifecycle mismatch; used only to validate the corrected reshard plan.

validation.broad_config_discovery: 98 unrelated failures from optional reverse_text and reverse_text_v1 plugins absent in the dirty vendored Verifiers checkout; 155 runnable tests passed and 1 skipped
validation.behavioral_claim: none; the checkpoint exists solely to prove the full execution path
